newsitem.title: UK: LME People - Chase adds to its metals team.
newsitem.headline: LME People - Chase adds to its metals team.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank announced it was expanding its base metals risk management business with "two significant additions" to its Global Commodities team.
It said Craig Tuckman joined in New York as vice-president for coverage of Western Hemisphere base metals customers. He had been with Bankers Trust responsible for global aluminium clients.

In London, Ros Wilson joined as a vice-president from J P Morgan as part of the global Base Metal sales team. Separately Chase said that in anticipation of the reorganisation of the ownership structure of the London Clearing House, Chase Manhattan International Ltd had been accepted as an Associate Broker Clearing Member of the London Metal Exchange.
It was anticipated that Chase Investment bank Ltd would cease to be a member of the LME by year's end.
